snippet.title: AHAPIKA – Heroic Agency. English trailer
snippet.description: AHAPIKA is a bullet-heaven game. Epic battles, hordes of ancient monsters and an exciting storyline. All this is the world of Ahapika, the best agency in all of Ancient Greece! Assemble a team of real heroes! Help anyone who asks for help.  Whether it's a simple fruiterers or the Supreme God of Olympus himself, your goal is to gain fame and honor by performing feats. Immerse yourself in the multifaceted world of intrigues of the Greek gods and fight for the fate of the Ecumene.
